reason: Compactness — the default scorer already penalizes prompts past 4000 chars. Test whether explicitly directing L1 toward terseness improves both fitness and prompt-length budget.
directive: Prompts past 4000 characters are penalized linearly by the composite scorer. Variants must be terse: every section earns its place by changing model behavior on at least one BBEH failure mode (wrong-span, budget exhaustion, hedging, invented tokens). Drop ornamental guidance; keep only what shifts model output.
